question: ______is the first Indian woman to have won a Grammy.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tanvi Shah**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• Tanvi Shah is the first Indian woman to win a Grammy Award.

• She received the Grammy Award in 2010 for her contribution to the song "Jai Ho" from the film "Slumdog Millionaire".

• Tanvi Shah has sung in multiple languages including Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Spanish, and Arabic.

• She collaborated with famous music composer A.R. Rahman for the song "Jai Ho".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Grammy Awards:**

• The Grammy Awards are presented annually by The Recording Academy to recognize achievements in the music industry.

• It is one of the four major American entertainment awards (EGOT: Emmy, Grammy, Oscar, and Tony).

• The awards cover various genres and technical categories, and winners receive a gold-plated statuette representing a gramophone.

• **Slumdog Millionaire:**

• "Slumdog Millionaire" is a 2008 British drama film directed by Danny Boyle.

• The film is an adaptation of the novel "Q & A" by Indian author Vikas Swarup.

• The soundtrack of the film, composed by A.R. Rahman, won multiple awards including the Academy Award for Best Original Score.

• **A.R. Rahman:**

• Allah Rakha Rahman is an Indian composer, singer, and music producer known for his work in Indian cinema.

• He is also known for his international music projects and has won multiple awards including two Academy Awards, two Grammy Awards, a BAFTA Award, and a Golden Globe.

• **Other Indian Grammy Winners:**

• Ricky Kej: An Indian composer and environmentalist who won a Grammy Award for his album "Winds of Samsara".

• Ravi Shankar: The sitar maestro who won multiple Grammy Awards and was also awarded a posthumous Lifetime Achievement Award.
